detail: All authored and stress cases gathered alive without towers and attacked for 200 uninterrupted ticks.
assetSource: Actual Bootstrap Luban tables and Editor assets through AssetDatabase. Player bundles, IL2CPP and devices are not covered.
timingScope: Step timings exclude geometry verification and presentation synchronization. Presentation timings measure CPU synchronization, not deferred rendering or GPU time.
